name: Drift Concord
stage: Planning; task contracts prepared, execution and product implementation not approved or completed

waves.title: Every seat matters
waves.outcome: Prove the crew loop with one expedition.

waves.title: One ship that behaves consistently
waves.outcome: Build the bounded systems needed by that mission.

waves.title: Bring the crew home
waves.outcome: Deliver the first complete cooperative run.

waves.title: Ships and stories persist
waves.outcome: Add identity without turning play into compulsory upkeep.

waves.title: An open fleet of communities
waves.outcome: Let independent operators host useful destinations.

waves.title: A game worth returning to
waves.outcome: Validate variety, performance and host workload.

tasks.title: Script the derelict expedition
tasks.goal: Define preparation, discovery, salvage, a recoverable failure and the return home.
acceptanceCriteria: The mission includes a consequential decision for pilot, engineer and field crew.
Document an alternate route to completion after one crew member disconnects.
tasks.body:
Define preparation, discovery, salvage, a recoverable failure and the return home.

acceptanceCriteria: New players can perform each interaction with visible feedback and remappable controls.
